body.p: XDM 4.0 maps keep insertion order. Design after Saxon 13 (Michael Kay, "Implementing Maps for XPath 4.0", XML Prague 2026):

item.p: a built-once list of key/value pairs plus a key-to-offset index, built lazily on first lookup;
a separate persistent layer for later map:put / map:remove;

entries addressable by position, needed for JNode sibling navigation. Confirmed at the Phase 0 gate; the design is in . The 2026 drafts dropped extensible record types (record(a, *)) and optional field markers (a?); a field whose type allows the empty sequence may be absent from a map that matches, and coercion fills it, so record cells hold every field.
